title: Cover journal admission census reuse and mixed capture-priority combinations
outcome: Behavioral regressions directly exercise one-pass full-admission refusal counts and the capture image's mixed pending, unavailable and captured-generation priority.
acceptance: A full-admission regression measures a single custody-inventory pass and verifies refusal counts describe the retained post-compaction image, including a restored journal above the limit.
Expected-value tests exercise pending plus unavailable captures and a matching generation plus an unavailable capture, preserving CapturePending and CapturedGeneration priority respectively.
